campaign.portfolio_description: Postpaid mobility customers targeted for Add-A-Line cross-sell

include.logic: Include only customers on the Koodo postpaid mobility base
Include only customers with an AAL recommendation model score ranked 1 to 5
Include only customers whose preferred language is French

exclude.term: Exclude those added a line in the past 30 days
exclude.logic: Exclude customers who have added a line to their account within the last 30 days

contact_strategy_override.condition: Contact strategy is applied as a standard rule; no override indicated

segmentation.geography: Priority communities in Quebec requested (Quebec City-Levis, Trois-Rivieres, Longueuil, Granby-Bromont, Shawinigan, Outremont, Sherbrooke-Magog, Mount-Royal, Drummond, Saguenay) but requirement was rejected — city names not aligned to CITY field in marketing database

Quebec bilingual note references English-preferred customers in Quebec receiving bilingual creative — this is a creative/compliance instruction and does not affect audience targeting logic, but may require a language flag split
Segmentation codes and creative codes for Base 1 segments are entirely blank — no segment-level targeting differentiation is defined

campaign_summary: This campaign targets Koodo postpaid mobility customers who are French speakers, scored in AAL recommendation model ranks 1-5 (note: this criterion was flagged as removed as of October 2024 and should be confirmed), to promote adding a new line to their existing account via outbound calling through TI Morocco. Customers who have added a line in the past 30 days are excluded, along with standard default exclusions including call DNC suppression, stop-sell, non-primary subscribers, and CASTL compliance. A UCG control holdout is applied, though the holdout percentage has not been specified.

unmapped_terms: Exclude those added a line in the past 30 days
